title: Tiled
description: Adds customizable and craftable Tile Blocks!
body: ### Have you ever wanted to build custom tiled floors? How about making compact gradients between blocks, or creating your own murals/wallpapers/paintings in a vanilla friendly way? With Tiled, you can! Tiled adds optimized and customizable Tile Blocks and Small Tile Blocks to the game! The Tile Blocks have 4 tiles, while the Small Tile Blocks have 16 tiles, allowing for endless creative possibilities! ## Tile Blocks Tile Blocks can be crafted with any combination of concrete blocks placed in a 2x2 square. In total you can make 65536 different Tile Blocks! ## Small Tile Blocks Small Tile Blocks can be crafted with any combination of concrete blocks placed in a 4x4 square! In total you can make over 18 quintillion different Small Tile Blocks! ## Tiling Table But how do you get the 4x4 crafting you ask? Well, that's where the Tiling Table comes in! This new workstation allows you to create both Small Tile Blocks and regular Tile Blocks actually and even has its own inventory, so you don't lose your tile layout when you close the UI! The Tiling Table is crafted with 2 polished andesite, an iron ingot, and ANY concrete block! Also, a solid color Tile Block or Small Tile Block can replace a concrete block of that color in Tile Block and Small Tile Block crafting recipes! ## Tile (items) and Small Tile (items) Tiles items and Small Tile items are a way to help reduce inventory clutter by allowing you to craft individual tile blocks. A concrete block put in the crafting table gets you 24 Tile items and a concrete block put in the Tiling Table gets you 96 Tile items. To make a Tile Block use 6 each of 4 Tile items in the Tiling Table and to make a Tiles block you only need 1 each of 4 Tile items. To make a Small Tile Block use 6 each of 16 Small Tile items in the Tiling Table and to make a Small Tiles block you only need 1 each of 16 Small Tile items. ## Tiles (block) and Small Tiles (block) These blocks behave like their full block counterparts, except that they place like glow lichen, allowing you to effectively tile the side of any full block in the game! ## Tile Trowel This item is crafted with an iron ingot above a stick and lets you swap out the tiles on a Tile Block, Small Tile Block, Tiles, or Small Tiles. To manipulate a Tile Block or Tiles, hold the Tile item you want to "paint" with in your offhand. To manipulate a Small Tile Block or Small Tiles, hold the Small Tile item you want to "paint" with in your offhand. I hope you all enjoy the mod and the builds you can make with these new blocks!
